slices.focus: Kelli and Travis install a basic ramp for aging blue heeler Juno and patch the fence before winter worsens.
slices.summary: Juno starts slipping on icy back steps and a fence section gives way in hard winter wind, so Kelli and Travis pay for a basic ramp and partial fence repair. They choose basic and safe over ambitious, acknowledging that money is tight. Kelli notes the ramp changes how the yard feels — adapting the house to an older season — and plans a three-line spring follow-up list.
